en.headline: Hong Kong Food Carnival continues at Kwai Chung Sports Ground
en.dek: The nine-day event organised by the Chinese Manufacturers’ Association features more than 330 booths across seven zones, with entry at HK$6 and free admission after 7 p.m.

zh.headline: 香港美食嘉年華葵涌運動場進行中
zh.dek: 中華廠商聯合會主辦的九日活動設超過330個攤位、七大主題區，入場費6元，晚上7時後免費。

en.headline: Observatory issues Yellow Fire Danger Warning for Sunday
en.dek: The Hong Kong Observatory raised the Yellow Fire Danger Warning at 6 a.m., indicating a high fire risk as dry conditions persist under the northeast monsoon.

zh.headline: 天文台發出黃色火災危險警告 周日火險頗高
zh.dek: 天文台於周日早上6時發出黃色火災危險警告，表示火災危險性頗高，市民及行山人士應提高警覺。

en.headline: Hong Kong Wine and Dine Festival returns at Central Harbourfront from 29 October
en.dek: The four-day event features more than 340 booths from 31 countries and regions, with star chefs and a new Coffee Village section, running into the early hours on Friday and Saturday.

zh.headline: 香港美酒佳餚巡禮10月29日起中環海濱舉行
zh.dek: 四日活動設超過340個來自31個國家及地區的攤位，有星級廚師及新增咖啡園專區，周五六延至凌晨1時。

en.headline: Halloween Month events continue across the city on Sunday
en.dek: Special party trams run on designated evenings and Kai Tak Sports Park hosts a market and cosplay activities through the weekend under the Tourism Board campaign.

zh.headline: 萬聖月活動周日繼續 全城多區有節慶安排
zh.dek: 特別派對電車於指定晚間行走，啟德體育園周末舉行市集及Cosplay活動，屬旅發局首辦萬聖月計劃一部分。

en.headline: Maritime and Aviation Training Fund commitment reaches HK$500 million
en.dek: Transport and Logistics Bureau secretary Mable Chan said the fund has supported more than 24,000 students and practitioners by September after successive top-ups.

zh.headline: 海事及空運人才培訓基金承擔總額達五億港元
zh.dek: 運輸及物流局局長陳美寶表示，基金經多次注資後，截至九月已惠及超過二萬四千名學生及從業員。

en.headline: Two projector stands removed from Peak lighting project after outcry
en.dek: Commissioner for Tourism Ann Chan inspected the Lugard Road site Saturday morning, and the metal stands that held industrial projectors were gone by afternoon, leaving only their foundations.

zh.headline: 山頂光影項目兩座投影機支架已拆除 居民早前反對
zh.dek: 旅遊事務專員陳慧茜周六早上視察盧吉道及夏力道一帶，下午大型金屬支架已被移除，只剩地基。

en.headline: Asian Games athletes to join Sha Tin bus parade next Tuesday
en.dek: Gold medallists in rowing and windsurfing are among those who will meet residents during an open-top bus tour organised by the Sha Tin District Office and Festival Committee.

zh.headline: 亞運港隊運動員下周二參與沙田巴士巡遊與市民見面
zh.dek: 賽艇金牌趙顯臻、滑浪風帆金牌黃梓豪等將出席，巡遊由沙田節委員會與沙田民政處合辦，當日亦派發紀念品。

en.headline: MTR sends trains for inspection after passengers report odors on two lines
en.dek: Staff found no smell after passengers on the Tsuen Wan and Tuen Ma lines said they felt unwell around 9 p.m. on Friday, and the company has reported the matter to police.

zh.headline: 港鐵接獲乘客反映列車異味 已安排列車返廠檢查並報警
zh.dek: 昨晚約9時，荃灣線油麻地站及屯馬線土瓜灣站有乘客反映列車有異味，部分人輕微不適，職員未發現異味，港鐵已報警。

en.headline: Chief Executive congratulates Hong Kong athletes on 41-medal Para Games haul
en.dek: Hong Kong, China finished the Asian Para Games in Nagoya with three gold, 14 silver and 24 bronze medals, including a women’s sabre team silver on the final day.

zh.headline: 行政長官恭賀港隊亞殘運奪41面獎牌
zh.dek: 香港代表團在名古屋亞殘運以3金14銀24銅完結，最終日女子佩劍團體賽再添一銀。

en.headline: Private car mounts pavement at Fan Kam Road bus stop, injuring three
en.dek: A green convertible struck a minibus and then a bus stop in Pat Heung this morning, leaving a man, a woman and a six-year-old girl with minor injuries.

zh.headline: 粉錦公路私家車剷上巴士站 撞傷3名候車途人包括6歲女童
zh.dek: 今早約8時43分，一輛開篷跑車在八鄉打石湖巴士站附近撞及小巴後衝上行人路，3名候車市民擦傷送院。

en.headline: HKU holds undergraduate information day highlighting AI and new programmes
en.dek: The campus event runs until 6 p.m. under the theme Shape a More Sustainable World with AI, and the university has proposed two new bachelor’s programmes for 2027-28.

zh.headline: 港大本科入學資訊日今日舉行 聚焦AI跨學科應用並推介新課程
zh.dek: 活動以「啟航未來·AI共創可持續世界」為主題，校方計劃於2027-28學年推出文學士精英及機器人工程學兩項新本科課程，正待審批。

en.headline: Immigration Department opens new e-Channel registration station at Huanggang port
en.dek: The station on the departure level lets parents register children aged 7 to 17 on the spot for cooperative inspection e-Channels, with the director inspecting operations on Saturday.

zh.headline: 皇崗口岸5樓離境層增設e-道登記站 方便家長即場為子女登記
zh.dek: 入境處今日表示，新登記站協助未用手機應用程式登記的市民及7至17歲子女，完成後可使用合作查驗e-道，處長郭俊峯到場視察。

en.headline: Hong Kong boccia pair win gold on Asian Para Games final day
en.dek: Leung Yuk-wing and Cheung Yuen beat China 9-0 in the mixed BC4 doubles, while the team also took two bronzes.

zh.headline: 亞殘運硬地滾球 梁育榮張沅9比0勝中國組合奪金
zh.dek: 港隊在最後比賽日再添一金兩銅，硬地滾球項目表現突出。

en.headline: Police and Shenzhen authorities bust cross-border credit card fraud syndicate
en.dek: Thirty-three people were arrested in a joint operation over at least 60 cases involving more than HK$1.8 million, targeting Hong Kong visitors in Shenzhen.

zh.headline: 警方聯同深圳公安搞破跨境信用卡詐騙集團 拘33人
zh.dek: 行動涉最少60宗案件，騙款逾180萬港元，專門針對赴深圳熱門地點的香港市民。

en.headline: Customs seizes 600 million illicit cigarettes in first nine months
en.dek: Commissioner Chan Tsz-tat said the haul nearly matched the 2025 annual total, with 200 million sticks intercepted en route to other destinations.

zh.headline: 海關首九個月檢獲六億支私煙 接近去年全年總量
zh.dek: 海關關長陳子達表示，其中2億支原擬運往其他地方，因接獲情報在港截獲。

en.headline: Health Department investigates suspected misuse of HIV testing website email
en.dek: Fake emails and messages claimed recipients faced HIV infection risk. No data loss or leakage has been found so far, and the site is suspended.

zh.headline: 衛生署HIV測試網站電郵戶口疑被不當使用 暫無資料外洩
zh.dek: 冒充署方發出電郵或短訊稱收件人有感染風險，網站已暫停運作，市民可致電愛滋熱線預約檢測。

en.headline: Kwai Chung slope becomes rat haven as departments step up control
en.dek: The Food and Environmental Hygiene Department has received three complaints this year about rats on a slope near Tai Lung Street Rest Garden, and joined the Leisure and Cultural Services Department in inspections on…

zh.headline: 葵涌大隴街斜坡現鼠患 部門加強防治
zh.dek: 食環署今年接獲 3 宗相關投訴，周五應康文署要求到場視察並提供技術意見。

en.headline: Crypto platform on alert lists opens Causeway Bay office
en.dek: Polar Tensor, listed by Hong Kong and Canadian regulators, opened an office at One Hysan Avenue in August, prompting experts to call for scrutiny of its marketing.

zh.headline: 列入監管警示名單的加密貨幣平台在銅鑼灣開設辦公室
zh.dek: Polar Tensor 於 8 月在希慎道壹號開設辦公室，專家促請加強監察其推廣手法。

en.headline: Transport chief says 16,000 have applied for taxi and ride-hailing exam
en.dek: Mable Chan expects the first batch of ride-hailing platform licences to be announced from late November to early December, while noting the government will scrutinise bus fare applications.

zh.headline: 運輸局局長指的士及網約車綜合筆試已有 1.6 萬人報考
zh.dek: 陳美寶表示，網約車平台牌照首批結果料於 11 月底至 12 月初公布，並會審慎考慮巴士加價申請。

en.headline: Private secondary schools rise 56 per cent in five years
en.dek: The Education Bureau said the number of private secondary schools grew from 16 to 25 between 2021-22 and 2025-26, citing a stronger economy and changing parental preferences.

zh.headline: 私營中學五年間增逾五成 教育局指經濟及家長偏好轉變
zh.dek: 教育局數字顯示，私營中學由2021-22學年的16間增至2025-26學年的25間，增幅達56.3%。

en.headline: Man arrested over suspected poisoning of stray cats in Shek Kip Mei Park
en.dek: Police arrested a 34-year-old man early on Saturday after volunteers said they caught him placing suspected rat poison in cat food at Shek Kip Mei Park.

zh.headline: 石砫尾公園疑投毒害貓 34歲男涉殘酷對待動物被捕
zh.dek: 警方今日凌晨在石砫尾公園拘捕一名34歲男子，身上檢獲懷疑老鼠藥及一把約14厘米長的生果刀。

en.headline: Father arrested after nine-year-old girl injured in Tuen Mun knife incident
en.dek: Police said a man was taken in for investigation after his nine-year-old daughter was injured in the chest while he tried to take a knife from her early on Saturday at On Ting Estate.

zh.headline: 屯門安定邨9歲女童持刀 父奪刀時傷及女兒 涉傷人被捕
zh.dek: 警方稱，今日凌晨一名男子在安定邨嘗試從女兒手中奪刀時，9歲女童胸口受傷送院，案件暫列傷人。

en.headline: Chief Secretary Chan departs for Dongguan GBA talent conference
en.dek: Chan Kwok-ki leaves for Dongguan this afternoon to attend the opening of the fourth Greater Bay Area High-quality Talent Development Conference and related events on Sunday.

zh.headline: 政務司司長陳國基赴東莞出席大灣區人才大會
zh.dek: 陳國基今天下午前往東莞，出席星期日舉行的第四屆粵港澳大灣區人才高質量發展大會暨相關創新創業大賽開幕儀式。

en.headline: Legco sets up subcommittee to review tighter land records access rules
en.dek: Lawmakers endorsed a subcommittee at the House Committee meeting on Friday to examine proposed restrictions under the Land Titles Regulation after concerns from some legislators and the Journalists Association.

zh.headline: 立法會成立小組委員會審議收緊土地查冊安排
zh.dek: 立法會內務委員會周五通過成立小組委員會，研究《業權規例》下擬議的土地紀錄查閱限制，此前部分議員及記者協會提出關注。

en.headline: TST East Halloween Beats holds free cosplay DJ party today
en.dek: Sino Group’s Tsim Sha Tsui Centre and Empire Centre stage the Movie Magic themed event at Mody Road Garden from 4pm to 10pm, with Hong Kong Tourism Board support.

zh.headline: 尖東萬聖節音樂盛事今日舉行免費變裝DJ派對
zh.dek: 信和集團旗下尖沙咀中心及帝國中心主辦的活動，以電影狂想曲為主題，於麼地道花園下午4時至晚上10時舉行，並獲旅遊發展局支持。

en.headline: Hong Kong seals deals for local gold refineries to boost trading hub
en.dek: Agreements with Swiss and mainland firms will allow refining in the city, completing a full gold trading ecosystem as storage capacity targets expand.

zh.headline: 香港簽協議引入本地黃金精煉廠 推進交易中心
zh.dek: 與瑞士及內地公司達成協議，將在港設立精煉設施，完善黃金交易生態，並配合倉儲擴容目標。

en.headline: The Weeknd opens four-night Kai Tak Stadium run tonight
en.dek: The Canadian artist begins the Hong Kong leg of his After Hours Til Dawn tour at Kai Tak Stadium, with shows continuing over the next two weekends.

zh.headline: The Weeknd今晚在啟德主場館展開四晚巡演
zh.dek: 加拿大歌手在啟德主場館開始After Hours Til Dawn巡演香港站，未來兩個周末繼續演出。

en.headline: URA advises against hiring Taizoom for lift subsidy scheme
en.dek: The Urban Renewal Authority said it has lost confidence in the contractor after inspections found missing fire-safety components in lifts at hundreds of buildings.

zh.headline: 市建局建議補貼計劃業主避免聘用臺日電梯
zh.dek: 市建局表示，因檢查發現數百幢大廈升降機欠缺防火組件，已對承辦商失去信心。

en.headline: Customs seizes 5.4 kg of cannabis buds at airport, two men charged
en.dek: Hong Kong Customs arrested two mainland passengers arriving from Vietnam and Thailand and seized suspected cannabis buds valued at about HK$1.1 million.

zh.headline: 海關機場檢5.4公斤大麻花 兩男同控販毒
zh.dek: 香港海關在機場拘捕兩名分別從越南及泰國抵港的內地男旅客，檢獲估計市值約110萬元的懷疑大麻花。

en.headline: Big C to close its Kolour Tsuen Wan store in early November
en.dek: The Thai supermarket chain confirmed the branch will shut after its lease ends, leaving the Tsuen Wan district without a Big C outlet for now.

zh.headline: Big C荃灣千色匯店11月上旬結業
zh.dek: 泰國連鎖超市確認荃灣千色匯分店因租約期滿將於11月上旬結束營業，荃灣區暫時再無Big C門市。

en.headline: Monster Mash Fest brings family Halloween activities to Central today
en.dek: Hongkong Land’s Halloween in Central event holds a free family day on Chater Road with costumes, face painting and a themed bouncy castle.

zh.headline: 中環大小怪獸嘉年華今日舉行親子萬聖節活動
zh.dek: 置地公司「萬聖狂歡祭．中環」於遮打道舉辦免費親子日，設服裝攤位、臉部彩繪及主題彈跳城堡。

en.headline: Police say white powder in letters to media and library poses no blast risk
en.dek: Four reports of letters containing white powder sent to three media outlets and a public library were classified as the discovery of suspicious items after checks found no explosive danger.

zh.headline: 警方指傳媒及圖書館粉末信無爆炸危險
zh.dek: 三間傳媒機構及一間公共圖書館接獲藏有白色粉末的信件，經爆炸品處理課檢查後相信無爆炸危險，案件暫列發現可疑物品。

en.headline: Gloomie Museum exhibition at Harbour City runs until 25 October
en.dek: Local artist Leon Lai’s first solo show featuring his Gloomie cat character is open at Gallery by the Harbour until Sunday, with paintings and sculptures reinterpreting art history and Hong Kong scenes.

zh.headline: 海港城Gloomie Museum展覽延至25日
zh.dek: 本地藝術家Leon Lai首個個人展覽以Gloomie貓為主題，在海港城Gallery by the Harbour展出至周日，以畫作及雕塑重現藝術史與香港場景。

en.headline: MTR offers half-price fares on Thank You Day today
en.dek: Passengers using Octopus or QR codes on the MTR, Light Rail and selected buses receive a 50 per cent discount on every fare-paying trip on 24 October.

zh.headline: 港鐵感謝日今推行車費半價優惠
zh.dek: 乘客今日以八達通或二維碼乘搭港鐵、輕鐵及指定巴士，每程付費車程可享半價優惠，包括東鐵綫過境車程。

en.headline: Observatory keeps Red Fire Danger Warning in force
en.dek: The Hong Kong Observatory said the Red Fire Danger Warning remains in force, indicating extreme fire risk under the dry northeast monsoon.

zh.headline: 天文台維持紅色火災危險警告
zh.dek: 香港天文台表示，紅色火災危險警告仍然生效，顯示在乾燥東北季候風影響下火災危險性極高。

en.headline: Finance Committee approves HK$1.6 billion to extend newborn baby bonus
en.dek: Lawmakers approved extra funding to prolong the scheme by three years and raise the second-child payment to HK$30,000, as set out in the Policy Address.

zh.headline: 財委會通過16億元額外撥款延長新生嬰兒獎勵金計劃
zh.dek: 立法會議員批准增撥款項，把計劃延長三年，並把第二名子女獎勵金提高至3萬元，落實施政報告措施。

en.headline: Three-year-old boy critically ill with influenza complications
en.dek: The Centre for Health Protection said the child, who has a chronic illness and visited the United States during the incubation period, remains in intensive care at Tuen Mun Hospital.

zh.headline: 三歲男童感染流感併發嚴重併發症情況危殆
zh.dek: 衞生防護中心表示，這名有長期病患的男童潛伏期曾到美國，目前仍在屯門醫院兒童深切治療部留醫。

en.headline: Observatory maintains Strong Monsoon Signal with northerly winds
en.dek: The Hong Kong Observatory said strong winds exceeding 40 kilometres per hour from the north are expected, with occasional gale-force gusts, and advised precautions.

zh.headline: 天文台維持強烈季候風信號 預期北風強勁
zh.dek: 香港天文台表示，預期北風平均風速超過每小時40公里，陣風間中達烈風程度，並提醒市民採取預防措施。

en.headline: Para fencer Tong Nga-ting named flagbearer for Asian Para Games closing
en.dek: The China Hong Kong Paralympic Committee said Tong, who has won three medals in Nagoya, will carry the flag at Saturday’s closing ceremony.

zh.headline: 殘疾人劍擊選手湯雅婷獲委任亞殘運閉幕禮持旗手
zh.dek: 中國香港殘疾人奧委會宣布，在名古屋奪得三面獎牌的湯雅婷將於周六閉幕禮擔任持旗手。

en.headline: Hang Seng Index closes 0.69 per cent higher at 23,093
en.dek: Hong Kong stocks rebounded on Friday, with the benchmark rising 158 points on turnover of about HK$250 billion after earlier fluctuations.

zh.headline: 恒生指數收報23093點 升0.69%
zh.dek: 港股周五反彈，恒指升158點，全日成交約2498億元，早段曾波動後回升。

en.headline: Two imported dengue cases recorded in the past week
en.dek: The Centre for Health Protection said the patients had visited India and Bangladesh, bringing this year's total to 36 cases, mostly imported.

zh.headline: 過去一周新增兩宗外地傳入登革熱個案
zh.dek: 衛生防護中心表示，兩名病人分別到過印度及孟加拉國，今年累計36宗，大多為輸入個案。

en.headline: Tuen Mun Hospital opens neuroscience centre for integrated care
en.dek: The centre co-locates wards, operating theatres and rehabilitation on one floor, introducing advanced technologies including magnetic resonance-guided focused ultrasound.

zh.headline: 屯門醫院神經醫學中心開幕 提供跨專科綜合服務
zh.dek: 中心將病房、手術室及復康設施集中同一樓層，並引入磁波刀及術中磁力共振等先進科技。

en.headline: Fine and very dry weekend ahead with large day-night temperature gap
en.dek: The Observatory forecasts fine and hot conditions on Saturday with a high near 32 degrees, followed by mainly fine and dry weather on Sunday.

zh.headline: 周末天晴非常乾燥 日夜溫差仍然較大
zh.dek: 天文台預測周六天晴炎熱，最高氣溫約32度，周日大致天晴及乾燥。

en.headline: Health Bureau to start patient pairing with community pharmacies
en.dek: The first phase of the Community Pharmacy Programme will pilot pairing arrangements in four districts by the end of October, with 20 designated pharmacies.

zh.headline: 醫衞局月底啟動社區藥房病人配對安排
zh.dek: 社區藥房計劃首階段將於十月底在東區、油尖旺、沙田及元朗試行，共20間指定藥房。

en.headline: Degree holders’ starting pay advantage over sub-degree graduates narrows
en.dek: A Baptist University survey found the gap between bachelor’s and sub-degree starting salaries fell to HK$2,500 this year from HK$3,000 last year.

zh.headline: 調查指學位與副學位畢業生起薪差距收窄至2500元
zh.dek: 浸會大學大灣區薪酬調查顯示，本科與副學位畢業生平均起薪差距由去年3000元降至今年2500元。

en.headline: Traditional sauce maker Kui Lee to close after 90 years
en.dek: The family business, established in 1936, will shut its Wan Chai shop once remaining stock is sold after its Kwu Tung factory was cleared for the Northern Metropolis.

zh.headline: 經營九十年醬園鉅利將結業 古洞廠房因北都收地停產
zh.dek: 1936年成立的家族醬園，在古洞廠房因北部都會區收地清拆後，灣仔零售店售罄存貨即永久結業。

en.headline: Hong Kong paddlers claim silver and bronze at Asian Para Games
en.dek: Chiu Kan-shan and Wong Yue-ching took silver in women's doubles while Ho Ka-sing and Wong Chi-yin secured bronze in men's doubles in Nagoya on Friday.

zh.headline: 港隊乒乓選手於亞殘運再添銀銅牌
zh.dek: 趙君山與黃宇晴在女子雙打奪銀，何嘉成與黃志賢在男子雙打獲銅，賽事周五在名古屋舉行。

en.headline: Hong Kong records hottest Frost solar term on record at 32.1 degrees
en.dek: The Observatory said the temperature at its headquarters reached 32.1 Celsius by 2.30pm on Friday, breaking the previous mark for the traditional calendar period.

zh.headline: 本港錄得有紀錄以來最熱霜降 天文台總部下午達32.1度
zh.dek: 天文台表示，周五下午2時半總部氣溫達32.1度，打破該節氣的歷史最高紀錄。

en.headline: Observatory maintains Red Fire Danger Warning as risk remains extreme
en.dek: The Hong Kong Observatory issued the warning at 6am on Friday, advising the public to take extra fire precautions amid dry conditions.

zh.headline: 天文台維持紅色火災危險警告 火險極高
zh.dek: 香港天文台周五上午6時發出警告，提醒市民在乾燥天氣下特別提高警覺並採取防火措施。

en.headline: Chinalco sets up corporate treasury centre in Hong Kong
en.dek: The state-owned aluminium giant will use the new entity to manage offshore funds, financing and risk, highlighting the city’s role as a hub.

zh.headline: 中鋁集團在港設立企業財資中心
zh.dek: 這家國有鋁業巨頭將透過新實體管理離岸資金、融資及風險，突顯香港作為財資中心樞紐的角色。

en.headline: Security chief says legislative reforms on fire safety are forthcoming
en.dek: Chris Tang told a radio programme that administrative measures already taken would be followed by legislative changes after the Tai Po fire report.

zh.headline: 保安局長指消防安全立法改革即將推出
zh.dek: 鄧炳強在電台節目表示，過去一年已採取行政措施，隨大埔火災報告提交後將有立法改革。

en.headline: More than 70 Hong Kong-Taiwan flights cancelled as Super Typhoon Champi approaches
en.dek: As of Friday afternoon, services by Cathay Pacific, HK Express and others to Taoyuan, Kaohsiung and Taichung have been scrapped, with the storm’s peak impact lasting through the night.

zh.headline: 超強颱風薔琵逼近 逾70班港台航班取消
zh.dek: 截至周五下午，國泰、香港快運等航空公司往返桃園、高雄及台中的航班已取消，風暴高峰影響持續至晚間。

en.headline: Police arrest two women over alleged child abuse after girl's video plea
en.dek: An 11-year-old girl in Wong Tai Sin was found with swollen limbs after posting videos seeking help; her grandmother and a domestic helper have been detained.

zh.headline: 警方黃大仙拘兩女涉虐兒 十一歲女童拍片求救
zh.dek: 一名十一歲女童在社交媒體上載影片求救後，被發現手腳紅腫；其外祖母及一名印尼外傭已被警方拘捕。

en.headline: Customs seizes HK$4.6 million in illicit cigarettes and counterfeits in Sha Tau Kok
en.dek: Officers arrested a 50-year-old saleswoman after raiding a Chung Ying Street shop and finding about 720,000 suspected duty-not-paid cigarettes plus counterfeit goods.

zh.headline: 海關沙頭角檢獲約460萬元私煙及冒牌貨 拘捕一名女子
zh.dek: 海關周三在中英街一間零售店檢獲約72萬支懷疑私煙及約2700件懷疑冒牌物品，並拘捕一名50歲女售貨員。

en.headline: Citywide Halloween cosplay events continue across five districts this weekend
en.dek: The Hong Kong Tourism Board’s first Halloween Month features street parties in Central, Kai Tak, Lan Kwai Fong, Mong Kok and Tsim Sha Tsui East on Saturday.

zh.headline: 全城萬聖節Cosplay活動本周末五區繼續舉行
zh.dek: 旅發局首個萬聖節月於中環、啟德、蘭桂坊、旺角及尖東舉行街頭派對，本周六有活動。

en.headline: Sources say Tai Po fire report names four government bodies for accountability
en.dek: The independent committee’s report, submitted on Thursday, is understood to highlight the Housing Bureau’s Independent Checking Unit among others, without naming individual officials.

zh.headline: 消息指大埔火災報告點名四個政府部門須負責
zh.dek: 獨立委員會周四提交的報告據悉點名房屋局獨立審查組等四個部門失職，但沒有點名個別官員。

en.headline: Air quality reaches serious levels, experts urge elderly to stay indoors
en.dek: The Environmental Protection Department recorded serious and very high health risk levels at several stations amid elevated ozone, with conditions expected to persist for a few more days.

zh.headline: 空氣質素達嚴重水平 專家建議長者留在室內
zh.dek: 環保署多個監測站錄得嚴重及甚高健康風險級別，主因臭氧水平上升，料情況未來數日持續。

en.headline: Customs seizes 8kg of cannabis at airport, two men arrested
en.dek: Two incoming passengers from Bangkok were arrested on Thursday after officers found about 8 kilograms of suspected cannabis buds valued at roughly HK$1.7 million in their luggage.

zh.headline: 海關機場檢獲8公斤大麻花 兩名男子被捕
zh.dek: 兩名從曼谷抵港的入境乘客周四被截獲，行李內藏約8公斤懷疑大麻花，市值約170萬港元。

en.headline: HSBC launches RedCoin stablecoin for PayMe users
en.dek: The Hong Kong dollar-backed stablecoin is rolling out in stages from Friday for more than 3.3 million PayMe users, supporting peer-to-peer and merchant payments.

zh.headline: 滙豐推出RedCoin穩定幣供PayMe用戶使用
zh.dek: 港元穩定幣由周五起分階段向逾330萬名PayMe用戶推出，支援個人對個人及商戶付款。

en.headline: Lan Kwai Fong Monster Mash returns for three Halloween Saturdays
en.dek: The district’s cosplay and street party events run on 17, 24 and 31 October from 7pm to 11pm, with DJs, face painting and roaming performances.

zh.headline: 蘭桂坊怪物巡禮夜重臨 三個星期六舉行
zh.dek: 活動於10月17、24及31日晚上7時至11時舉行，設有DJ、化妝及街頭表演。

en.headline: Hong Kong government condemns UK six-monthly report as interference
en.dek: The government said the report contained false and misleading remarks and urged Britain to stop interfering in Hong Kong affairs which are internal matters of China.

zh.headline: 特區政府強烈譴責英國半年報告 斥干預香港事務
zh.dek: 政府指報告內容失實及抹黑，強調《中英聯合聲明》沒有賦予英國干預回歸後香港事務的權利，英國對香港無主權、無治權及無監督權。

en.headline: M+ presents Myths and Monsters survey of Asian fantasy art
en.dek: The exhibition is described as the first major survey exploring two centuries of Asian fantasy visual culture, featuring more than 400 works across fine art, film, fashion and games.

zh.headline: M+呈獻《神話與怪物》亞洲幻想藝術大型展覽
zh.dek: 展覽被形容為首個全面探討兩個世紀亞洲幻想視覺文化的大型調查，展出逾400件跨越純藝術、電影、時裝及遊戲的作品。

en.headline: Centre for Food Safety finds malachite green in imported bluefin tuna sample
en.dek: The sample tested under the routine surveillance programme contained 1.74 parts per billion of the prohibited substance, and the importer has been notified.

zh.headline: 食安中心在進口藍鰕吞拿魚樣本檢出孔雀石綠
zh.dek: 樣本含孔雀石綠1.74十億分率，中心已知會進口商並追查來源及分銷情況。

en.headline: Tertiary student sentenced to 10 years for sexual offences against underage girls
en.dek: High Court Judge Andrew Chan noted the 22-year-old showed no remorse after one 14-year-old victim took her own life following an attempted rape.

zh.headline: 大專生承認性侵未成年少女等12罪 判監10年
zh.dek: 高等法院法官陳慶偉指22歲被告范致遠毫無悔意，其中一名14歲受害人遭企圖強奸後輕生。

en.headline: Link Hong Kong Open offers free public admission for opening rounds
en.dek: The 65th edition continues at Hong Kong Golf Club in Fanling through Sunday, with free entry on Thursday and Friday and complimentary access for under-18s all week.

zh.headline: 領展香港高爾夫球公開賽首兩日免費開放公眾入場
zh.dek: 第65屆賽事在粉嶺香港哥爾夫球會舉行至周日，周四及周五免費入場，18歲或以下人士全周免費。

en.headline: MTR to offer half-fare travel on Thank You Day this Saturday
en.dek: Passengers using Octopus, JoyYou Card or QR codes on most of the network, including East Rail Line border crossings, will pay half fare on 24 October.

zh.headline: 港鐵本周六感謝日提供半價乘車
zh.dek: 乘客使用八達通、樂悠咗或二維碼乘搭大部分網絡，包括東鐵綫過境車程，24日可享半價車費。

en.headline: Digital Policy Office urges immediate patches for critical PHP vulnerabilities
en.dek: The office issued a security alert to government departments and public organisations after two critical flaws in the widely used web language were disclosed.

zh.headline: 數字辦呼籲即時修補PHP嚴重安全漏洞
zh.dek: 數字政策辦公室向政府部門及公營機構發出保安警報，要求全面檢視系統並盡快完成修補。

en.headline: Authorities say missing lift fire door frames confined to Taizoom
en.dek: Inspections found no similar omissions among other contractors after 338 buildings serviced by Taizoom Elevator were confirmed to lack the components.

zh.headline: 機電署指升降機缺失防火門框僅限臺日電梯
zh.dek: 當局表示，除臺日電梯外，其他承辦商維修的升降機未發現同類缺失防火門框組件的情況。

en.headline: Chan Yui-lam takes Hong Kong’s second gold at Asian Para Games
en.dek: The swimmer won the women’s 100 metres butterfly S14 in 1 minute 5.19 seconds, with teammate Lau Chiu-kee claiming bronze.

zh.headline: 亞殘運陳睿琳女子蝶泳奪金 港隊再添金牌
zh.dek: 她以1分05.19秒勝出女子S14級100米蝶泳，隊友劉肖儀得銅牌，是港隊本屆第二面金牌。

en.headline: Chow Tai Fook expects interim profit to rise 90 to 100 percent
en.dek: The jewellery group attributed the increase mainly to fair value gains on gold loan contracts and improved sales in core markets.

zh.headline: 周大福發盈喜 料中期盈利升約九成至一倍
zh.dek: 集團指升幅主要來自黃金貸款合約重估帶來的公允價值收益，以及核心市場銷售改善。

en.headline: OASES welcomes seventh batch of 18 strategic enterprises
en.dek: The firms are expected to add to a cumulative HK$84 billion in investment and about 27,000 jobs from 142 strategic partners to date.

zh.headline: 引進辦公布第七批18家重點企業
zh.dek: 連同過往批次，142家重點企業預計帶來約840億港元投資及約2.7萬個職位。

en.headline: Hong Kong adds silver and three bronze medals in para table tennis
en.dek: Lam Yan-yu and Wong Hon-lam took silver in mixed doubles XD20, while three other pairs secured bronze after losing in the semi-finals.

zh.headline: 亞殘運乒乓球港隊奪一銀三銅
zh.dek: 林恩羽與黃瀚林混合雙打XD20級得銀牌，另三對組合在四強失利後獲銅牌。

en.headline: Hang Seng Index closes 3.03 percent lower at 22934.68
en.dek: The benchmark fell 717 points as the Hang Seng Tech Index dropped 5.03 percent, with Alibaba, Meituan and Xiaomi among the heaviest blue-chip losers.

zh.headline: 恒生指數收報22934.68點 全日跌3.03%
zh.dek: 恒指收跌717點，恒生科技指數挫5.03%，阿里巴巴、美團及小米等藍籌科技股領跌。

en.headline: September inflation rises to 1.9 percent, underlying rate at 2.1 percent
en.dek: The Composite CPI increased more than in August, driven mainly by faster rises in transport fares and package tour charges, the Census and Statistics Department said.

zh.headline: 9月綜合消費物價指數按年升1.9% 基本通脹率2.1%
zh.dek: 升幅較8月擴大，主要因進出香港交通費及套裝旅遊費用升幅加快，統計處公布。

en.headline: Unemployment rate rises to 3.9 percent in July to September
en.dek: The seasonally adjusted rate edged up 0.1 percentage point from the previous three-month period, with underemployment also rising to 2.0 percent.

zh.headline: 7至9月失業率升至3.9% 就業不足率升至2%
zh.dek: 經季節性調整失業率較前一三個月期微升0.1個百分點，失業人數增至15.5萬人。

en.headline: HK Express cancels 10 Taiwan flights on Friday as Typhoon Champi approaches
en.dek: The budget carrier will scrap six Hong Kong–Taipei services and cancel or defer others to Taichung and Kaohsiung, offering free rebooking or refunds to affected passengers.

zh.headline: 香港快運周五取消10班台灣航班 因超強颱風薔琵逼近
zh.dek: 快運宣布取消六班往返台北航班，另有台中及高雄航班取消或改期至周六，受影響旅客可免費改期或退款。

en.headline: Buildings Department applies tighter national standard for scaffold safety nets
en.dek: From 1 September, contractors must test nets manufactured under GB 5725-2025, which sets a two-second limit on afterflame and afterglow for dip-coated nets.

zh.headline: 屋宇署採用更嚴格棚網國標 浸漬塗覆網阻燃要求收緊至兩秒
zh.dek: 自9月1日起，承建商須按GB 5725-2025新標準測試新製棚網，浸漬塗覆網的續燃及陰燃時間上限由四秒收緊至兩秒。

en.headline: Nine injured as two KMB double-deckers collide in Tuen Mun
en.dek: A route 258D bus struck the rear of a route 66M bus near Shan King Estate on Ming Kum Road shortly after 8am, with both drivers among the casualties.

zh.headline: 屯門兩九巴相撞九人受傷
zh.dek: 早上約8時15分，258D線紅色九巴在鳴琴路山景邨對開撞向停在燈位的66M線金色九巴車尾，兩名車長在內共九人輕傷。

en.headline: Health official warns of longer flu season as child vaccination rates fall
en.dek: Edwin Tsui said more than 900,000 doses have been given this season, about 10 percent fewer than the same period last year, with rates down across age groups.

zh.headline: 衞生防護中心總監警告流感季或較去年長 兒童接種率下跌
zh.dek: 徐樂堅指接種計劃至今已打逾90萬劑，較去年同期少約一成，各年齡組別接種率均下降。

en.headline: Wild boar captured in Victoria Park after morning sighting
en.dek: Agriculture, Fisheries and Conservation Department staff used a tranquiliser dart to remove the one-metre animal from the Causeway Bay park after police secured the area.

zh.headline: 維多利亞公園野豬出沒 漁護署施麻醉槍後運走
zh.dek: 今早約7時一頭約1米長野豬闖入銅鑼灣維園，警方持盾戒備，漁農自然護理署人員於上午用麻醉槍將其捕獲運走。

en.headline: Man arrested over alleged indecent exposure to five schoolgirls in Yau Tong
en.dek: Police detained a 26-year-old man after two incidents involving secondary school students near a playground and estate in the district.

zh.headline: 油塘26歲男涉向五名女學生露體被捕
zh.dek: 警方拘捕一名26歲男子，涉兩度在鯉魚門道遊樂場及油麗邨附近向中學女學生暴露臀部。

en.headline: Hang Seng Index drops more than 600 points by midday
en.dek: The benchmark fell below 23,000 points in the morning session as technology and financial shares weighed on the market.

zh.headline: 恒生指數半日跌逾600點失守23000點
zh.dek: 港股周四上午重挫，科技及金融股拖累，恒指半日報約22972點，較上日收市跌近680點。

en.headline: Independent committee submits Tai Po fire report to Chief Executive
en.dek: The judge-led panel delivered its two-volume findings on the Wang Fuk Court blaze that killed 168 people, with John Lee pledging swift reforms and accountability.

zh.headline: 大埔宏福苑火災獨立委員會向特首提交報告
zh.dek: 法官領導的委員會周四早上把報告交予李家超，特首表示短期內公布全面改革及追究責任，公開版本須先經法律審視。

en.headline: Police to hold highest honour funeral for senior officer Zhu Chun-kwok
en.dek: The force will conduct the ceremony on Friday for the officer who was stabbed while on duty in 2005 and died in September after 21 years.

zh.headline: 警務處周五為朱振國舉行最高榮譽喪禮
zh.dek: 2005年執勤遭割頸後臥床21年的高級警員朱振國9月離世，警隊周五於紅磡世界殯儀館舉行最高規格喪禮，其後安葬浩園。

en.headline: Peng Kanglong ink exhibition begins second rotation at Tai Kwun
en.dek: INKstudio’s solo show of nearly 40 works by the contemporary ink artist runs its second rotation from today until 28 November.

zh.headline: 彭康隆水墨個展第二階段於大館墨齋展開
zh.dek: 近40件作品的個展「迷路只為看花開」第二輪替今日起至11月28日於中環大館展出。

en.headline: Receivers sell Shimao’s Tung Chung hotels for HK$2.7 billion
en.dek: The Sheraton and Four Points by Sheraton complex on Lantau, with 1,219 rooms, is sold to a buyer linked to Malaysian developer ParkCity.

zh.headline: 世茂東涌喜來登酒店銀主盤以27億元出售
zh.dek: 大嶼山雙品牌酒店共1,219間客房，售予與馬來西亞發展商ParkCity有關的買家，預計年底前完成。

en.headline: Health officials warn of risks from cadaver-derived beauty injections after raids
en.dek: The Department of Health seized unregistered Elravie Re2O products that claim to contain human tissue and arrested a woman, citing lack of clinical safety data.

zh.headline: 衞生署警告屍皮針有公共衞生風險 突擊搜查後拘捕女子
zh.dek: 署方在四間美容處所檢獲未經註冊的Elravie Re2O針劑，聲稱含人類組織，並指產品缺乏臨床安全數據。

en.headline: Ocean Park’s Halloween Fest continues with night-time haunted experiences through early…
en.dek: The Grave Rave season includes Under the Castle and other attractions on designated evenings until 1 November, according to the park.

zh.headline: 海洋公園哈囉喂全園祭持續 指定晚間驚嚇體驗至11月1日
zh.dek: 主題「詭魅墓會」日間活動每日開放至11月1日，夜間鬼屋等體驗於指定日子舉行。
